title: Owner-selected bubble transforms and coefficient-robust Schwarz preconditioners for variable-degree $hp$ finite elements
summary: We construct $h$- and $p$-robust, degree-preserving space decompositions and additive Schwarz preconditioners for variable-degree $hp$ finite element discretizations of conforming reaction-diffusion and fitted-interface problems. On conforming simplicial meshes, an owner-selected Falk--Winther bubble transform gives $L^2$- and $H^1$-stable components with constants independent of the mesh size, the local polynomial degrees, and the degree distribution.
